title: Meta to acquire RISC-V chip startup Rivos

sources.quote: Meta Platforms is set to acquire Rivos, a Santa Clara-based chip startup specializing in RISC-V architecture, Reuters reported, citing a source familiar with the matter.

explain: Meta agreed to buy Rivos, a startup designing chips on the open RISC-V standard, to speed up its in-house AI chip program and rely less on Nvidia. Terms were not disclosed.
